labels.aiIncludeCommitHistory: Include recent commit messages for style
labels.aiModelMaximumCompletionPrice: Maximum output price per million tokens
labels.aiModelMaximumPromptPrice: Maximum input price per million tokens

notes.aiInsecureEndpoint: This endpoint uses unencrypted HTTP. Only use it for a trusted local service.
notes.aiEndpoint: Enter the provider base URL. Gitmun appends the OpenAI-compatible or Claude request route.
notes.aiCommitContextLimit: Sets the maximum input for each provider request. Larger staged diffs are summarised across multiple requests. Total staged context above 1,024 KiB is blocked.
notes.aiContextLimitWarning: Large limits may increase provider costs, expose more repository data, and exceed the model's context window.
notes.aiOutputTokens: Allowed range: 1 to 65,536 tokens. The model or provider may impose a lower limit.
notes.aiCommitMessagePrompt: Gitmun also supplies the active subject limit, recent commit messages, staged file list, and staged diff. Clear this prompt and save to restore the default.
notes.aiConflictResolutionPrompt: Gitmun supplies stable region IDs and requires structured JSON proposals. Clear this prompt and save to restore the default.
notes.aiEnvironmentManaged: This value is controlled by a launch-time environment variable and is read-only.
notes.aiExperimental: AI is bundled but opt-in. Disabling it hides AI settings and actions, and prevents requests without deleting profiles or credentials.
notes.aiGlobalExclusions: Matching paths are omitted from all AI context. Sensitive-path checks remain enabled in addition to these patterns.
notes.aiKeyConfigured: An API key is stored securely in the operating system credential store.
notes.aiKeyEnvironmentManaged: The API key comes from the launch environment. It cannot be viewed, stored, replaced or cleared here.
notes.aiKeyOptional: No API key is required for this local endpoint.
notes.aiModel: Enter the exact model ID accepted by your provider or compatible endpoint.
notes.aiManualModelFallback: You can always enter a model ID manually. Discovery errors never switch to a different catalogue.
notes.aiOpenRouterPriceUnits: Routing limits and catalogue prices use US dollars per million tokens.
notes.aiOpenRouterOAuth: Sign in to create and securely store an OpenRouter API key. Clearing it here does not revoke it from your account.
notes.aiOpenRouterOAuthCallback: OpenRouter authorisation was received. Return to Gitmun to finish connecting.
notes.aiUsageEmpty: No AI requests have been recorded in the last 30 days.
notes.aiPrivacy: AI runs only on demand. Before sending repository content, Gitmun shows the destination, files and context size and asks for consent. Credentials and authentication headers are not shown or logged. Sensitive-path blocking is best-effort and does not replace reviewing the outbound context.
notes.aiReasoning: Automatic uses low reasoning for commit messages and medium reasoning for conflict resolution. Provider default omits the reasoning setting.
notes.aiReasoningAccepted: The endpoint accepted the reasoning setting. A compatible service may accept the field without using it.
notes.aiReasoningUnsupported: The configured endpoint rejected reasoning controls. Use Automatic or Provider default.
notes.aiVisibility: Unavailable actions link back to this configuration. Enabled actions require a valid profile and credential, except supported loopback services.
notes.autoUpdates: Use About to check manually. Automatic checks only show the updater prompt on launch when this is enabled.
notes.diffToolNotConfigured: No known diff or merge tool is configured. Compare and merge-tool actions may not work unless you have configured one manually in your git config.
notes.gitConfiguration: These options update your global Git configuration (equivalent to `git config --global ...`).
notes.gitExecutable: This is the Git binary Gitmun is using. Saving it pins Gitmun to that executable; clear it to return to automatic lookup.
notes.gitOptions: These options control Git behaviour in Gitmun.
notes.credentialHelper: Leave blank to use Git's existing helper lookup. Use values such as `manager`, `manager-core`, `cache`, or `store`.
notes.gpgKeyserverVerification: When a GPG-signed commit uses a missing public key, Gitmun runs GnuPG with your configured keyservers to fetch it and then retries verification. This can reveal key lookup activity to keyserver or WKD operators and imports fetched keys into your GPG keyring.
notes.gpgProgram: Leave blank to use Git's default GPG lookup. On Windows, Gitmun also searches common Git for Windows and GnuPG install folders.
notes.lineEndings: Changing line ending conversion can make many files appear modified until the repository is renormalised.
notes.linuxGraphics: Takes effect on next launch. Use "Maximum compatibility" if you see rendering crashes or a blank window.
notes.linuxTerminal: Custom commands can use {path}. If omitted, Gitmun still starts the terminal from the repository folder.
notes.commitMessageRecommendedLength: Recommended maximum for the first line of a commit message. Set to 0 to disable.
notes.commitGraphExperimental: The commit graph is experimental and may show visually incorrect graph lines.
notes.localCopyExperimental: Local Copy is experimental. Files only includes hidden, ignored, untracked, and tracked files, so it can copy local secrets. It excludes Git metadata, preserves symbolic links, and may need temporary space equal to the resulting working tree.
notes.errorToastClearDelayMs: Applies when error messages are not kept open. Minimum 1000 ms.
notes.persistentErrorToasts: Only error messages stay open. Success and information messages still close automatically.
notes.repoOpenBehaviour: Controls in-app repository opens, including recent repositories. Shell and file manager launches open a new window unless the launcher asks to reuse one.
notes.rowStriping: Alternates list row backgrounds in changes and commit views for easier scanning.
notes.toolPathMissing: {{tool}} could not be found automatically. Saving will fail until you choose its executable.
notes.toolPathSearch: Gitmun searches PATH first, then common Windows install folders. If that fails, choose the executable manually.
notes.updateEndpoint: Advanced setting. Gitmun checks this latest.json URL for updates. Do not change this unless you know what you're doing.
notes.updatesManaged: Updates are managed by this platform package channel.
notes.updatesMicrosoftStore: Updates are checked and installed through Microsoft Store for this installation.
notes.vscodeMergeEditor: {{tool}}'s merge editor writes the result file when closed, so conflicts will be marked as resolved even if you close without explicitly accepting a side. Use the Accept buttons inside the editor to choose which version to keep.

status.aiKeyCleared: Cleared the stored AI API key.
status.aiKeyStored: Stored the AI API key in the operating system credential store.
status.aiOpenRouterConnected: Connected the current profile to OpenRouter.
status.aiOpenRouterConnecting: Waiting for OpenRouter authorisation in your browser.
status.aiUsageHistoryCleared: Cleared the local AI usage history.
status.diffToolPathFailed: Failed to load diff tool path: {{message}}
status.gitExecutableReset: Cleared Git executable override and returned to automatic lookup.
status.gitExecutableResetFailed: Failed to reset Git executable override: {{message}}

aiErrors.apiKeyInvalid: The API key contains characters that cannot be sent safely.
aiErrors.authHeaderInvalid: Enter a valid HTTP authentication header name.
aiErrors.authentication: The provider rejected the API key.
aiErrors.contextTooLarge: The required repository context exceeds the safe request limit.
aiErrors.credentialStoreUnavailable: The operating system credential store is unavailable.
aiErrors.configurationWriteFailed: Gitmun could not save the AI configuration.
aiErrors.endpointCredentialsForbidden: Do not include credentials in the endpoint URL.
aiErrors.endpointSchemeInvalid: The endpoint must use HTTP or HTTPS.
aiErrors.environmentManaged: This setting is controlled by the launch environment.
aiErrors.insecureRemoteEndpoint: Remote AI endpoints must use HTTPS.
aiErrors.invalidEnvironment: A launch-time AI environment variable is invalid.
aiErrors.invalidResponse: The provider returned an invalid response.
aiErrors.invalidExclusion: Enter at most 100 valid exclusion patterns, one per line.
aiErrors.modelCatalogueTooLarge: The provider model catalogue exceeds Gitmun's safe limit.
aiErrors.modelDiscoveryUnavailable: Model discovery is unavailable for this provider or model.
aiErrors.network: The provider could not be reached.
aiErrors.notConfigured: Complete and save the AI settings first.
aiErrors.openRouterOAuthFailed: OpenRouter could not complete the authorisation exchange.
aiErrors.openRouterOAuthInProgress: An OpenRouter sign-in is already in progress.
aiErrors.openRouterOAuthInvalidCallback: Gitmun received an invalid OpenRouter authorisation callback.
aiErrors.openRouterOAuthOfficialEndpointRequired: OpenRouter sign-in requires the official https://openrouter.ai endpoint.
aiErrors.openRouterOAuthUnavailable: Gitmun could not start OpenRouter sign-in.
aiErrors.outputTruncated: The provider stopped before completing the response.
aiErrors.reasoningUnsupported: This endpoint does not support the selected reasoning level.
aiErrors.responseTooLarge: The provider response exceeded the safe size limit.
aiErrors.routeInvalid: Enter valid provider route and routing values.
aiErrors.unsafeRedirect: Gitmun blocked an authenticated provider redirect.
